# Rocky headland: a 16-sided block 11 x 8.5 m, its top 4 m above the sea (its foot 1.2 m under it), cut into bands and jittered so
# the cliff faces break into big facets; turf on the faces that look up. Up Z, sea level z 0.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Cliff --vertices 16 --radius 5.5 --depth 5.2 --location 0 0 1.4
scale 1 0.78 1
apply --scale
apply --location
material new Rock --base-color 0.133 0.137 0.137
material new Turf --base-color 0.941 0.965 0.941 --no-slot
active Cliff
mode edit
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 3.2 --plane-no 0 0 1
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 2.2 --plane-no 0 0 1
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 1.2 --plane-no 0 0 1
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 0.2 --plane-no 0 0 1
# the top keeps its height (the lighthouse and hut stand on it); everything below it breaks up
select vert where "pos.z < 3.9"
randomize --amount 0.7 --seed 11
select vert where "pos.z > 3.9"
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 12
select face where "normal.z > 0.75"
material assign Turf
# the bottom cap is under the sea: no splats for it
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
shade flat
export cliff.glb
